items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: And the last time he came in here, he came in here just by himself. And, uh, he was loafing. And, uh, he played a few dances here with us.

ctx.x: Now, such me. I wouldn't know. He came in here in a time or two, but a couple of Augustus. And the last time he came in here, he came in here just by himself. And, uh, he was loafing. And, uh, he played a few dances here with us. And up and then we gone, even to Jackson. And, uh, Joe Black, uh, sensation, a drummer used to be at Rappersfield. He had an orchestra, uh, there.
Is that Joe Black or Joe White?
